user_direction: The two primary metrics are discrete I_perp and densified Delta E.

timing_and_disclosure.observed_information_before_amendment: The alpha=0.1 result and online sparse diagnostic logs for alpha=0.1 and the running alpha=10 member had been observed. This amendment is therefore reported as user-directed and not as outcome-blind preregistration.
timing_and_disclosure.bias_control: Apply the same amended metric definitions to every eligible state of every candidate and every baseline before any promotion decision; do not selectively densify only favorable candidates.

scope.supersedes_for_final_comparison: the arc500 I_perp component of final_arc500_ranking in the parent protocol
preserves: the staged controlled-scan and promotion counts
the optimization Number of Forces contract

discrete_I_perp.tangent: normalized central chord x[i+1]-x[i-1] on the 32-image path
discrete_I_perp.forces: the already-paid forces at the 30 internal images of that exact eligible state

densified_Delta_E.source_path: the same scientifically eligible 32-image state used for discrete I_perp
densified_Delta_E.energy_evaluator: the same canonical OpenMM 8.1.2 CPU/double energy oracle for every candidate, path state, and baseline

ranking_policy.common_initial_path_densification: Evaluate once with the identical 500-point rule and bind its path, coordinates, energies, and metric hashes.

normalization.u_I: discrete I_perp(state) / discrete I_perp(common initial path)
normalization.u_E: densified Delta E(state) / densified Delta E(common initial path)

ranking_policy.per_run_score_at_budget_B: Among eligible post-initial reparam_committed states with optimization NoF <= B, choose the one state with the smallest joint_score; never combine the I_perp from one state with the Delta E from another.
ranking_order: smaller u_I on that same state
smaller u_E on that same state
smaller actual optimization NoF of that state
registered lexicographic order of alpha, then r, then m_max
ranking_policy.pareto_reporting: Always report the two raw primary metrics and the Pareto relation. The joint score is a deterministic promotion rule, not a replacement for the two physical metrics.
ranking_policy.right_censoring: A valid run without a post-initial reparam_committed path is not rankable at that budget.

diagnostic_execution_policy.alpha_scan: After all eight 480-NoF alpha members are sealed, evaluate densified Delta E for every eligible post-initial reparam_committed state before selecting the three alpha promotions.
diagnostic_execution_policy.later_stages: At every promotion boundary, seal all optimization results in the comparison set first, then evaluate every eligible state under the same 500-point rule before selection.
diagnostic_execution_policy.failure_policy: A path with any failed or missing densified energy evaluation has no valid densified Delta E and cannot be ranked; preserve its diagnostic ledger and do not substitute its sparse barrier.
diagnostic_execution_policy.no_feedback: Offline diagnostics may select the next registered parameter setting or budget extension but may never alter a completed or running optimization trajectory.
diagnostic_execution_policy.ledger: Record diagnostic energy attempts, successes, failures, point indices, source-path hash, densified-coordinate hash, energy hash, metric value, oracle hash, host, precision, and wall time separately from optimization NoF.

plotting_policy.left_metric: discrete I_perp from the 32-image eligible path
plotting_policy.right_metric: densified Delta E from the uniform arc-length 500-point representation of that same eligible path
plotting_policy.vertical_axis: Number of Forces from optimization only
plotting_policy.sparse_barrier_role: runtime health diagnostic only; never plotted or used for ranking
plotting_policy.dense_I_perp_role: not a primary metric and not required for ranking or the requested figures

binding_rule: Every selection receipt, densified diagnostic audit, promoted-member registration, final metric table, figure, and provenance document created after this amendment must record this amendment file and its SHA-256. Existing alpha-screen execution authorizations remain valid because this amendment changes only offline analysis and cannot affect their trajectories.
